spans.s:
Praūga is apparently equivalent to pra-yuga, denoting the fore part of the pole of the cart, the part in front of the yoke. It is mentioned in the yajurveda Saṃhitās and the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, where it is said to be the part of the pole behind the kastambhī, or prop on which the pole rests.
Foot notes taittirīya Saṃhitā, v. 4, 11, 1, 2; kāṭhaka Saṃhitā, xxi. 4.
Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, i. 1, 2, 9; iii. 5, 3, 4, etc.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 248; Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East, 12, 14, n. 1.
